import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static long[][][][] dp;
    static int capacity, fatCount, slimCount;
    static long[][] nCr;
    static final long MOD = 1000000007L;

    static long solve(int remainingFat, int remainingSlim, int remainingTrips, boolean boatOnLeft) {
        if (remainingFat == 0 && remainingSlim == 0 && remainingTrips == 0) {
            return 1;
        }
        if (remainingTrips == 0) {
            return 0;
        }
        int boatIndex = boatOnLeft ? 0 : 1;
        if (dp[remainingFat][remainingSlim][remainingTrips][boatIndex] != -1) {
            return dp[remainingFat][remainingSlim][remainingTrips][boatIndex];
        }

        long result = 0;
        if (boatOnLeft) {
            for (int f = 0; f <= remainingFat; f++) {
                for (int s = 0; s <= remainingSlim; s++) {
                    if (f + s > 0 && f * 2 + s <= capacity) {
                        long ways = (nCr[remainingFat][f] * nCr[remainingSlim][s]) % MOD;
                        result = (result + (ways * solve(remainingFat - f, remainingSlim - s, remainingTrips - 1, !boatOnLeft)) % MOD) % MOD;
                    }
                }
            }
        } else {
            int fatMoved = fatCount - remainingFat;
            int slimMoved = slimCount - remainingSlim;
            for (int f = 0; f <= fatMoved; f++) {
                for (int s = 0; s <= slimMoved; s++) {
                    if (f + s > 0 && f * 2 + s <= capacity) {
                        long ways = (nCr[fatMoved][f] * nCr[slimMoved][s]) % MOD;
                        result = (result + (ways * solve(remainingFat + f, remainingSlim + s, remainingTrips - 1, !boatOnLeft)) % MOD) % MOD;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return dp[remainingFat][remainingSlim][remainingTrips][boatIndex] = result;
    }

    static long modPow(long base, long exp, long mod) {
        long result = 1;
        base %= mod;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                result = (result * base) % mod;
            }
            base = (base * base) % mod;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        int n = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine().trim());
        capacity = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine().trim()) / 50;
        fatCount = 0;
        slimCount = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            int weight = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine().trim());
            if (weight == 100) {
                fatCount++;
            } else {
                slimCount++;
            }
        }

        dp = new long[fatCount + 1][slimCount + 1][201][2];
        for (int i = 0; i <= fatCount; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= slimCount; j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k <= 200; k++) {
                    dp[i][j][k][0] = -1;

        }

        for (int i = 0; i <= 50; i++) {
            nCr[i][0] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
                nCr[i][j] = (nCr[i - 1][j - 1] + nCr[i - 1][j]) % MOD;
            }
        }

        for (int trips = 1; trips <= 200; trips++) {
            long count = solve(fatCount, slimCount, trips, true);
            if (count > 0) {

                System.out.println(count);
